lighting.Soft window light: Soft window light falls from one side, with gentle shadow transitions and a natural balance of highlights and shadows.
lighting.Open shade: Even daylight in open shade, with soft shadows and restrained highlights.
lighting.Overcast daylight: Diffuse overcast daylight, with broad illumination and delicate shading.
lighting.Direct sunlight: Direct sunlight creates crisp directional shadows and distinct highlights, with detail retained in the lit and shaded areas.
lighting.Golden hour: Low golden-hour sunlight creates warm directional highlights and long, soft-edged shadows.
lighting.Studio softbox: A large studio softbox provides directional light with smooth shadow transitions and controlled highlights.
lighting.On-camera flash: Direct on-camera flash gives a candid photographic look, with crisp highlights and a clear falloff into the background.
lighting.Indoor practical light: Available indoor light from nearby lamps, with gentle falloff and believable differences between lit and shaded areas.

style.Natural photography: A natural photograph with believable photographic detail, restrained contrast, and realistic color rendering.
style.Unretouched portrait: An unretouched photograph with lifelike detail and the subtle irregularity of a real photographic capture.
style.Candid documentary: Candid documentary photography with an observational feel, natural color, and restrained processing.
style.Editorial photography: Editorial photography with precise detail, controlled contrast, and a polished but lifelike finish.
style.Film photograph: A film photograph with fine, subtle grain, gentle highlight roll-off, and restrained color grading.

skin_texture.Natural texture: Visible skin retains subtle pores, fine texture, and gentle variations in tone, with highlights that follow the lighting.
skin_texture.Close-up detail: Where the image is close enough, skin shows fine pores, delicate facial hairs, and subtle texture at a believable scale.
skin_texture.Soft natural texture: Skin has softly resolved natural texture and gentle tonal variation, with smooth transitions between light and shadow.
